description: Header file defining the TlsChloExtractor class, which extracts information from QUIC-TLS Client Hello messages, including parsing packets, handling TLS handshake details, and interfacing with QUIC framer and stream sequencer.

classes.name: TlsChloExtractor
classes.description: Class for extracting and parsing QUIC-TLS Client Hello messages from network packets, managing TLS handshake state, and providing parsed data such as ALPNs and server name.

methods.name: IngestPacket
methods.description: Processes a received packet to extract TLS handshake information.

methods.name: HasParsedFullChlo
methods.description: Checks if a complete Client Hello has been successfully parsed.

methods.name: tls_alert
methods.description: Returns the TLS alert code if an unrecoverable error occurred.

methods.name: StateToString
methods.description: Converts internal state enum to a human-readable string.
